I can't confirm the exact number, but I believe the Crystal Ring Shield is a light small shield that needs only about 8 to 10 Strength. I'm not changing my answer because of the team note. It gives no source, and I don't think a "crystal-themed" shield implies a medium-shield requirement like the Heater Shield's 12. I'm working from memory and haven't checked a stat table.

CONFIDENCE: 55
